title: rosa × dumetorum subvar. semiglabra
intro: Rosa × dumetorum subvar. semiglabra, commonly known as Chinese rose or Rosa semiglabra, is a species of rose that is native to China and has a semi-glabrous or partially hairy stem. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × dumetorum subvar. semiglabra include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular-protective properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils. The plant's bioactive constituents are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions.
